messages:
alex: Quick interlock: SOC2 fieldwork next Wed. Need final signoff on KMS/HSM runbook and auditlog retention. Ping owners.

mariela: I can own runbook signoff. @samira can you confirm HSM validation checklist is green?

samira: Working on it. Two items blocking: staging HSM attestation and log export retention policy. ETA EOD Tue for attestation smoke.

nate: For auditlog retention, ops needs retention-slack to be forwarded to S3 lifecycle. I'll do config PR, can someone review?

leo: Assign me for PR review. Also need the sampleaccess proof artifact from security-tools. @mariela can you confirm owner?

mariela: Yep I'll pull the artifact from security-tools. ETA today. Also adding a canary test to runbook.

qa-ops: Heads up: we need a test harness for prefix-KV cache to ensure no PII leaks during export. @samira FYI.

samira: Acknowledged. I'll add a test case. small snippet:
```
curl -XPOST /internal/export -d '{"range":"last30d"}'
```

alex: Great. Two governance asks: (1) final signoff meeting Thurs 10am PT (canary + runbook walk), (2) confirm fallback plan to hosted model if HSM unavailable.

mariela: :thumbsup: Thurs 10 works.

nate: Fallback plan: route to dedicated KMS with KMS proxy in front. Need latency SLO checks. I'll write runbook section.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled runbook-docs update to prod at 2026-03-18T03:00Z by nate

oncall-bot: oncall-bot: Reminder — rotate keystore test creds before fieldwork window.

leo: Quick question: who owns the post-fieldwork evidence bundle? I can assemble but need a confirm on retention labels.

mariela: Security compliance team owns labels; I'll coordinate with them and loop you in.

samira: If staging attestation fails, temp mitigation: enable auditlog mirror to non-prod S3. I'll add instructions.

qa-ops: I'll create the test harness ticket and assign to @samira and @nate. Ticket: INF-1347

alex: Thanks all. Action items recap: mariela runbook & artifacts, samira attestation + tests, nate retention PR + runbook fallback, leo PR review + evidence bundle. Meeting Thurs 10am PT. :spiral_calendar:

mariela: Adding calendar invite now. cc:security-tools

leo: On it, will review PR tomorrow morning.
